text: /* @component: .accordion-container */document.addEventListener('click', function(e) { const header = e.target.closest('.accordion-header'); if (!header) return;  const t = header.parentElement; if (!t || !t.classList.contains('accordion')) return;  const active = t.classList.contains('_is-active'); const parent = t.parentElement;   function cl(el) { if (!el) return; el.querySelectorAll('.accordion._is-active').forEach(nt => {   nt.classList.remove('_is-active');   cl(nt.querySelector('.accordion-content')); }); }  document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-container').forEach(container => {  if (!container.contains(t) && !t.contains(container)) {   container.querySelectorAll('.accordion._is-active').forEach(nt => {     nt.classList.remove('_is-active');   }); } }); [...parent.children].forEach(s => { if (s !== t && s.classList.contains('accordion')) {   s.classList.remove('_is-active');   cl(s.querySelector('.accordion-content')); } });   if (active) { t.classList.remove('_is-active'); cl(t.querySelector('.accordion-content')); } else { t.classList.add('_is-active'); }});
